camdrones.planner.title: Flight Planner
camdrones.planner.live.tooltip: Watch the paired drone's camera like when spectating (wear goggles; the drone only transmits while flying). If it flies without a pilot, you steer the gimbal like a camera operator.
camdrones.planner.live.unavailable: No live view: the drone must be flying and within video range, and you need to wear goggles.
camdrones.planner.map.tooltip: Show or hide the top-down map. Hidden, the list gets more room.
camdrones.planner.map.help: Click: add waypoint · Right-click: point of interest · Drag a point: move it · Drag empty space: pan · Mouse wheel: zoom
camdrones.planner.mission.name: Mission name
camdrones.planner.mission.add.tooltip: Create a new empty mission (up to %s in the planner)
camdrones.planner.mission.delete.tooltip: Remove this mission from the planner
camdrones.planner.mission.base_speed.too: Speed between waypoints without their own speed. Shift: bigger steps.
camdrones.planner.mission.curves.tooltip: Sharp: stop at every waypoint. Smooth: fly on in an arc without stopping.
camdrones.planner.mission.end.tooltip: What happens after the last waypoint: hover, fly back to the start, land or start over.
camdrones.planner.mission.obstacle.toolt: Stop at an obstacle or climb over it (Tour and Cine only).
camdrones.planner.mission.ground.tooltip: Height above the block for waypoints set by right-clicking in the world or clicking the map.
camdrones.planner.mission.record.tooltip: Record a flight: while flying, a waypoint is added every 10 m and at every change of direction.
camdrones.planner.mission.exit.tooltip: What the paired drone does when you leave the FPV view: hover in place, fly home or land. Saved on the drone right away.
camdrones.planner.list.add_waypoint.tool: Insert a waypoint after the selected one, 10 m further along the course
camdrones.planner.list.add_poi.tooltip: Add a point of interest at the selected waypoint (up to 4)
camdrones.planner.list.empty: No waypoints yet. Right-click a block with the planner, press “+ Waypoint” or click the map.
camdrones.planner.detail.locked: Mission in an unknown format – it can only be deleted
camdrones.planner.detail.hint_map: Pick a point on the map or click it to add a waypoint.
camdrones.planner.detail.hint_list: Pick a waypoint in the list or press “+ Waypoint”.
camdrones.planner.detail.poi_hint: Drag it on the map. Waypoints looking “at P” turn nose and camera here.
camdrones.planner.detail.multi: Applies to all %s selected waypoints. Hold Alt: each changes by the step.
camdrones.planner.detail.type_hint: Double-click the value to type it.
camdrones.planner.entry.invalid: Not a number – fix it or press Esc
camdrones.planner.field.height.tooltip: Height above the start point: where the linked drone stands, otherwise where you stand. Left half lowers, right half raises, Shift: 5 m.
camdrones.planner.field.speed.tooltip: Speed on the way to this point; “base speed” uses the mission speed.
camdrones.planner.field.wait.tooltip: How long the drone hovers at this point.
camdrones.planner.field.tilt.tooltip: Gimbal tilt at this point, blended smoothly in between.
camdrones.planner.field.heading: Look
camdrones.planner.field.heading.tooltip: Where nose and camera point: along the course, fixed, at a point of interest or free for the operator.
camdrones.planner.field.yaw.tooltip: Fixed direction in degrees (0 = north), only with look “fixed”.
camdrones.planner.field.action.tooltip: What happens at the point: nothing, photo, start or stop recording.
camdrones.planner.button.send.tooltip: Send the mission to the paired drone. It then lives on the drone and survives picking up and restarts.
camdrones.planner.button.start.tooltip: Start or resume the mission on the drone
camdrones.planner.button.pause.tooltip: Pause the mission, the drone hovers
camdrones.planner.button.auto.tooltip: Automatic flight of the paired drone without a pilot: pull back, rise, circle or spiral around the subject in front of it. Starts from the ground or from a hover and holds its position afterwards
camdrones.planner.button.follow.tooltip: The paired drone follows you without a pilot: behind you, alongside you or watching from where it is. While you fly it yourself, the style applies to the Follow me switch
camdrones.planner.button.template.toolti: Append a ready-made path: circle, reveal or line
camdrones.planner.button.save.tooltip: Save all missions in the planner
camdrones.planner.template.circle.toolti: 12 waypoints in a 20 m circle around the selected point of interest or the map centre, looking at the centre
camdrones.planner.template.reveal.toolti: Backwards and rising away from the subject, camera stays on the subject
camdrones.planner.template.line.tooltip: Insert a point every 10 m between the last two waypoints, otherwise 60 m straight ahead
camdrones.planner.auto.retreat.tooltip: Flies backwards and climbs for %1$s s, the camera stays on the subject %2$s m in front of the drone
camdrones.planner.auto.rise.tooltip: Climbs straight up for %1$s s while the camera tilts down
camdrones.planner.auto.circle.tooltip: One circle in %1$s s around the subject %2$s m in front of the drone, nose towards the centre
camdrones.planner.auto.spiral.tooltip: Circles the subject %2$s m in front of the drone for %1$s s, widening by %3$s m and climbing
camdrones.planner.follow.behind.tooltip: Follows %1$s m behind you and %2$s m up, the camera stays on you
camdrones.planner.follow.parallel.toolti: Flies along %1$s m beside you and %2$s m up, the camera stays on you
camdrones.planner.follow.watch.tooltip: Stays where it is and only turns, the camera keeps you in the picture
camdrones.planner.status.poi_full: Up to %s points of interest per mission
camdrones.planner.status.template_full: The template no longer fits into the mission
camdrones.planner.status.not_linked: Pair first: sneak + right-click the drone with the planner
camdrones.planner.status.offline: Server without the camera drones add-on
camdrones.planner.status.follow_switch: Style set for the Follow me switch
camdrones.planner.upload.not_found: Drone not found – is it loaded in this world?
camdrones.planner.upload.distance: Waypoint %s too far from the start
camdrones.planner.upload.unavailable: The drone cannot take a mission right now
camdrones.planner.exit.result.ok: Exit behaviour saved on the drone
camdrones.planner.exit.result.not_found: Drone not found – is it loaded in this world?
camdrones.planner.exit.result.unavailabl: The drone can't take settings right now
camdrones.planner.placed.added: Waypoint %s set (%s m above the block) – %s
camdrones.planner.placed.locked: Mission in an unknown format – pick another one in the planner
camdrones.planner.pair.occupied: Someone else is flying this drone
camdrones.planner.pair.not_owner: This drone belongs to someone else
camdrones.planner.service.title: Drone mission
camdrones.planner.service.none: No mission on the drone – plan one in the flight planner and press “Send”.
camdrones.planner.service.hint: Plan in the flight planner · start, pause and stop here too
camdrones.planner.flight.no_tablet: No flight planner in the inventory
camdrones.planner.tooltip.unlinked: Not paired – sneak + right-click your drone
camdrones.planner.tooltip.use: Right-click the air: editor · a block: waypoint · Sneak + right-click a marker: delete
camdrones.planner.settings.title: Camera Drones
camdrones.planner.settings.preview.toolt: Numbered markers and the flight line in the world while you hold the planner. The editor always shows the points.
